mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as lower rates increase present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to investor risk aversion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate below 4.0% and payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% monthly indicates labor market strength driving robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (m/m).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent federal funds rate above 5.0% and CPIAUCSL annual change exceeding 3.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 102.0 (index 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing output, strengthening corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1350.0 thousand units signal strong consumer demand for residential construction, boosting related sector profitability and producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1350.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production above 102.0 and housing starts exceeding 1350.0 thousand units indicates synchronized strength in manufacturing and construction sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 102.0 and HOUST > 1350.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through extended low-rate environment.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months.
